upstreamDomainSource: frappe/erpnext (GPL-3.0) — the ERP domain pattern, declared once in integrations/erp/module.yaml and integrations/erp/core/provenance.json and deliberately not restated here (one declaration, no second copy to drift)

policy.note: Every harvest below is a shape or an interface read from this repository's own code, or a module imported by name. No file was copied, vendored or translated into integrations/erp/api/, and no third-party code is vendored anywhere in this lane.

harvests.shape: an OpenAPI document emitted from its sources rather than hand-written, with a deterministic serialization and a committed artifact the gate re-emits byte for byte
harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/api/openapi.py emits the ERP document from integrations/erp/core/schemas — the components are the ERP-02 schemas with only their $ref targets rewritten — and scripts/check-erp-api.sh compares the committed artifact to a fresh emission

harvests.shape: a route surface read from the thing that serves it, so the document cannot describe a route the surface does not have

source.path: integrations/paperclip/api/surface.py (routes introspected from the client), identity/cpapi/control.py (the route-table facade)

harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/api/routes.py derives its kind vocabulary and transition actions from the ERP-02 model and its handler registry, and openapi.validate_document refuses a document that omits or invents a route

harvests.shape: a transport-free router and the standardized {ok,status,requestId,data,error} envelope
harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/api/surface.py imports compile_template, ok_envelope and error_envelope from it — the envelope is reused, not reimplemented — and integrations/erp/api/errors.py extends the same ApiError record for its boundary refusals

harvests.shape: a client contract: stable operation ids, a route declaration and the error vocabulary a client binds to
harvests.builtInstead: the document carries x-erp-routes, x-erp-errors and x-erp-action-permissions so a generated client binds to a derivation it can diff rather than to prose

harvests.shape: the authorization seam a serving surface must delegate to, with no allow path that skips it
harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/api/surface.py calls scope.authorize from exactly one method, with the request's tenant always the principal's own; scripts/check-erp-api.sh greps the single call site and mutates the authorizer to prove the driver notices
